label: Sync Gateway Application (Server RBAC role)
type: one of six fine-grained Server RBAC roles Couchbase Server 7.0.2 Developer Preview added specifically for Sync Gateway's Admin REST API. Lets the user manage Sync Gateway users/roles and read/write application data through Sync Gateway. Do not confuse with sgw:role or sgw:user (Sync Gateway's own channel-grant/identity objects that this Server role is used to administer, not a member of).
aliases_note: Same same-round self-fork shape as role:sync-gateway-configurator: A1 minted `role:sync-gateway-application` (display-label form), A2 independently minted `role:sgw-application`. Filed under the internal name; both folded as aliases.
evidence: Role: Sync Gateway Application (sync_gateway_app) ... The Sync Gateway Application role lets the user manage Sync Gateway users, roles, and data. It also allows the user to read and write application data through the Sync Gateway.
note: Round 28 first contact with the 7.0.2+ fine-grained Sync-Gateway-RBAC catalogue extension. Per rest_api_admin.json's own finding, this role (or Architect) gates 'Create a new user session' (POST /{db}/_session) - minting a Public-API session cookie on behalf of a named sgw:user - which is the finding that qualifies (without retracting) round 27's sgw:user hasNoRelationshipTo sgw:rbac-user: the two identity systems share no login, but a Server-RBAC holder in this role can administer and act on behalf of the channel-based one. See the qualifying note on relations/has-no-relationship-to.json.
